text:
incident-bot: ALERT (INC-2027-45) — hosted-api: elevated 5xx rate in us-east-1. Severity: P2. Pager: #eng-oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2027-45 :rotating_light:

Alex R: grabbing primary. seeing 5xx spike ~15:00 UTC. rate ~32% for /v1/generate across prod pool-12.

Mariam S: I'm on secondary; can jump if you need DB dive.

Alex R: initial triage: errors surfaced as "kvcache-miss -> NullPointer" in model-serving. logs:
```
[15:02:11] model-runtime ERROR model=redwood-3b shard=3 NullPointer at kv_cache.c:412
[15:02:13] gateway WARN upstream 502 backend=model-sock-3
```

Jordan (SRE): I'm looking at infra metrics. Connection errors correlate with two hosts in pool-12 hitting OOM-adj. Possibly kernel OOM killer triggered. Host list: host-12-03, host-12-07.

Kevin L: I can temporarily remove host-12-07 from LB to stop routing new requests. Doing `kubectl cordon host-12-07` and `kubectl drain host-12-07` now.

Alex R: mitigation steps I'm executing:
- disable prefix caching for redwood-3b to reduce memory pressure (runbook step 2.3)
- roll model-serving on host-12-03 (graceful restart)
- enable fallback routing to redwood-3b-quant (lower mem config) for non-SLA tenants

Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/hosted-api-oom

Mariam S: I'll take ownership of customer comms. Which customers affected?

Alex R: preliminary: 4 paying customers in orgs A/C/E reported increased errors (tickets: INC-1002, INC-1010), internal dashboard shows errors across both gen and chat endpoints. Severity for paid seats: degradation (not fully down).

Anika (PM): tagging product for impact assessment; please update product-facing status page if SLA risk.

Jordan (SRE): host-12-07 drained, moving to maintenance. host-12-03 shows heap pinned at 92%. OOM events at 15:05. Restarting container now.

incident-bot: Update: Pager duty escalated to L2 for memory pressure.

Alex R: Rolling restart completed on host-12-03. 5xx rate dropped from 32% to 8% in 7 minutes. Leaving host-12-07 out of rotation for now.

Kevin L: started canary redirect to quant variant for 10% traffic for gen endpoints:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/internals/routing -d '{"route":"gen","percent":10,"target":"redwood-3b-quant"}'
```

Mariam S: primary handoff because Alex needs to leave at 16:00 UTC. I'll be primary until 20:00 UTC. Kevin is secondary. Jordan will handle infra escalations overnight.

Alex R: Handoff notes:
- Active alerts: hosted-api 5xx (reduced but watch), node host-12-07 removed from LB, should not be re-added until kernel OOM root cause found.
- Mitigations in progress: restart complete on host-12-03; canary 10% to quant; prefix-cache disabled on redwood-3b.
- Next steps: complete heapdump and upload to /artifacts/INC-2027-45/heapdumps; SRE to analyze OOM trace; consider rolling kernel updates if OOM kernel bug confirmed.
- Runbooks: hosted-api-oom, model-runtime-fallback

Jordan (SRE): I'll take heapdump and run `gcore` now, uploading link: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/INC-2027-45/host-12-03.gcore.tar.gz

Kevin L: noted. I'll monitor latency/5xx for next 2 hours and keep canary at 10%. If 5xx > 5% for 15m, escalate to L3.

Mariam S: I'll update the status page and ping sales + CSMs for affected accounts. Drafting message now.

Alex R: leaving now — thanks team. @Mariam S primary, @Kevin L secondary. If anything new pops, page L2.

Mariam S: ack — taking primary. Coverage note: There is no dedicated DB on-call tonight between 22:00–02:00 UTC; if we need DB deep-dive, escalate to oncall-manager. I'll document the gap in the handoff doc.

incident-bot: NOTE: thread marked for follow-up. Add post-incident review and RCA tags when resolved. :white_check_mark:
